summary: Instagram engagement is near zero (median 0, last 4 posts zero engagement, -2 followers in 7 days). LinkedIn growing but only 2 posts with 0 real engagement. Lead gen posts score highest (1.62x) but n=8. High reel skip rates (63-76%) show hooks fail in first 3s. Bio violates rules: niche/region specific and offers free check outside website posts.
guidance:
- Rotate hook styles: question, contrast, top3 (avoid overusing comparison)
- Lead gen posts: speak to freelancers/agencies broadly, not developers; describe sheet generally (Google Places data, contacts, review counts, website checks, new openings)
- Image style: test desk-glow or silhouette (highest scores, though n<5)
- Never read like an ad; show developer's real work
- Avoid repeating 'Google Maps' phrasing used in 3 recent lead gen posts

instructions.research: List 5 pain points freelancers/agencies face when finding local business leads manually (time, bad contacts, no website check, missed new openings, disorganised data).
instructions.analysis: Compare the 3 published lead gen posts (Nov 13, 19, 23) — all used comparison/question hooks about Google Maps; note which got any saves/shares.
instructions.writer: Write a lead gen post with a question hook opening 'Freelancers, ever spend hours on Maps only to find dead emails?' Describe the sheet generally: local businesses from Google Places with contacts, review counts, website status, new openings. End with 'pay after approval' and DM for fit check.
instructions.image: Create a clean desk-glow style carousel: slide 1 hook, slide 2-3 problem (manual search pain), slide 4 what the sheet includes (bullets), slide 5 pay after approval + DM CTA. No demo/mockup claims.
instructions.video: Not needed for today's lead gen post.

Comment thoughtfully on 5 posts from Indian freelancers/agencies discussing client acquisition struggles — no self-promo, just genuine insight.
